summary: Diversified Energy Co filed an 8-K regarding its subsidiary DP Red River LLC issuing $850M in asset-backed notes (ABS XII) in a private placement. The offering comprised $590M Class A-1 notes at 6.016% and $260M Class A-2 notes at 6.910%, both due 2046. Proceeds redeemed existing ABS Maverick and ABS VI notes and were used for general corporate purposes. The notes are secured by producing assets in the Western Anadarko Basin. This is a routine debt refinancing transaction, not a special situation. No special situation event or structural change affecting equity holders is present.
